message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout right when I was about to catch up on my favorite show. Of course, my phone was down to 5% battery! I scrambled to find my power bank, and it reminded me how important it is to have backup power sources handy. I ended up using my lanterns for some cozy lighting and enjoyed a little tech-free evening instead. Have you ever had a tech mishap during a power outage?
